dedupe_keys.name: deslinde de dominio publico maritimo terrestre

description: Deslinde de Dominio Público Marítimo Terrestre is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. In order to promote effective protection of our coasts and to increase legal certainty for holders of rights on the coast, the demarcation lines of the entire Spanish coast are published. Coverage: Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. The portal shows the English title as "Maritime Land Public Domain Demarcation" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ministerio para la Transición Ecológica y el Reto Demográfico. Its keywords include costa, concesiones, Deslinde, mar, Dominio Público, medio ambiente. The listing shows 2021-09-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.miteco.gob.es/es/atencion-al-ciudadano/aviso-legal.aspx). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
